## The package pin and the engine floor

The npm pin lives in `package.json` (`openclaw@2026.9.8`) and the candy's own plan asserts
it, together with the engine range the package declares — `>=24.16.0 <25 || >=26.1.0`. The
floor moved at 2026.9.3 and excludes node 22 and node 25.x, so the check fails on a base
whose node is outside the range instead of running an unsupported runtime. The Arch
`nodejs` package in the CachyOS base satisfies it.

## Usage

```yaml
# box charly.yml
openclaw:
  candy:
    base: cachyos
    candy:
      - openclaw
```

```bash
charly alias install openclaw    # install host 'openclaw' command
openclaw config                  # uses the alias
```

## Used In Boxes

- `/charly-openclaw:openclaw` — the family's gateway image (this layer plus the `openclaw:` check verb)

## Port Relay

The gateway binds to `127.0.0.1:18789` (loopback only). A socat relay forwards from the
container's network interface to loopback, so every connection appears as loopback to the
gateway and OpenClaw's `allowedOrigins` requirement for the Control UI never applies. Same
pattern as the `chrome` candy (CDP on port 9222).
